description: Eleven AI is a browser-based AI voice generator that converts written text into lifelike, expressive speech, clones authorized voices, and designs original synthetic speakers. Key features - 300+ public voice styles across four language groups - Voice cloning from authorized reference recordings - Original voice design from a written description - Up to 1,000 characters per conversion with an editable audio workflow - Generation history and private, account-bound voice models Use cases Creators
